text:
Jordan: Quick flag - noticed invoice_preview > final by ~18% for tenant: solara-studios in last 6h. Preview = 4.7k tokens, final = 4.0k.

Leah: Any sample event_id?

Jordan: event_id=evt-20260601-4421. Edge envelope shows model_served=gpt4a-compact-quant and sampling_id present, but aggregator preview has two partials for same req_id.

Omar: Can you paste the trace snippet?

Jordan: pasted:
```json
{"req_id":"r-4421","event_id":"evt-20260601-4421","tenant":"solara-studios","sampling_id":"s-900","model_requested":"gpt4a","model_served":"gpt4a-compact-quant","tokens_in":200,"tokens_out":1200}
```

Leah: Preview aggregated tokens = 1400 (two partials: 1,050 + 350). Final billing replay dedupes by req_id -> 1,050. Why two partials?

Omar: Could be router fallback path rewriting attributes and clearing sampling_id, causing aggregator to assign a second partial into null bucket. Any recent router changes?
deploy-bot: Deployed router-normalize v7.0.0 at 2026-05-31T23:10Z. Changes: canonicalize model_alias and drop vendor postfix on fallback.

Leah: That matches pattern. Normalization path may not preserve sampling_id. Two immediate mitigations: (A) update preview merge to dedupe by req_id when present, (B) patch router to preserve sampling_id, (C) add sku_map alias synonyms so token factors match.

Jordan: For quick win I prefer (A) + (C). (A) reduces preview inflation quickly; (C) avoids SKU factor drift.

Omar: Agreed. Also add a Console field on invoice preview showing "alias_used_by_preview" vs "alias_used_by_billing" for transparency.

Leah: I'll open BILL-3799 and attach the query I'm running to list affected tenants.

Jordan: query I used:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, req_id, SUM(tokens) as preview_tokens, COUNT(DISTINCT sampling_id) as sampling_buckets
FROM preview.aggregates
WHERE window_start >= '2026-05-31T20:00:00Z' AND window_end <= '2026-06-01T04:00:00Z'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw.events e WHERE e.req_id = preview.aggregates.req_id)
GROUP BY tenant_id, req_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sampling_id) > 1
LIMIT 200;
```

Leah: returns 24 tenants. CSV attached to BILL-3799.

billing-bot: BILL-3799 created: "preview vs final delta - normalization rewrite" assigned to @Leah. Link: https://billing.redwood/tickets/BILL-3799

Omar: Plan: (1) Leah to patch preview merge to prefer req_id dedupe and deploy to canary (ETA 2h), (2) Jordan to add sku_map synonyms for quant SKUs (billing) today, (3) Omar to open PR to router to preserve sampling_id on fallback and add integration test.

Leah: Also adding a dashboard alert: preview_vs_final_token_delta_pct > 7% for 30m per-tenant. That should catch rollouts quickly.

Jordan: I'll kick off scoped recompute of preview aggregates for the CSV windows after the canary change is verified. I'll attach per-req diffs for support.

Omar: Postmortem items: (a) dedupe precedence doc (req_id > sampling_id > model_alias), (b) contract test between router and aggregator, (c) UI change for alias transparency, (d) add preflight check for router deploys verifying header preservation.

Leah: Sounds good. Will update BILL-3799 with canary link and recompute plan shortly.

Jordan: thanks all. :thumbsup:
